0022600199.text: The Dallas Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home, on a one-game win streak) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-7, 1-3 at home, on a one-game losing streak) with both teams nine games into the season. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), while Brooklyn is missing Egor Demin (leg, bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Mavericks won their three 2025-26 meetings 3-0, most recently a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026.
